title: UC Berkeley Financial Aid Disbursement and Enrollment Adjustment Procedure

data.label: [ACTION] Review Term Aid Application
data.title: Review Term Aid Application
data.description: Aid applies toward oldest charges in current/prior term of academic year.
data.source_sentence: When you receive aid, all of your accepted financial aid for a current term will apply toward charges on your account before refunds are issued.

data.label: [ACTION] Apply Aid to Oldest Charges
data.title: Apply Aid to Oldest Charges
data.description: Aid prioritizes oldest account charges before current charges.
data.source_sentence: Financial Aid applies to the oldest charges on the account before applying toward current charges.

data.label: [DECISION] Assess Reduced Course Load Status
data.title: Assess Reduced Course Load Status
data.description: Awards assume 12 units at semester start; grants adjust if taking reduced load.
data.source_sentence: At the start of the semester, Cal Grants and Pell Grants are awarded assuming you are enrolled in at least 12 units, but they pay differently.

data.label: [DEADLINE] Census Enrollment Level Check
data.title: Census Enrollment Level Check
data.description: Enrollment captured at end of 5th week of classes to recalculate grant awards.
data.source_sentence: We capture your enrollment level at the end of the 5th week of classes and adjust Cal Grants and Pell Grants accordingly.

deadline.text: end of the 5th week of classes

data.label: [ACTION] Adjust Cal Grant Allocation
data.title: Adjust Cal Grant Allocation
data.description: Cal Grant award offer reduced to match verified enrollment level.
data.source_sentence: The amount of your Cal Grant award offer will be reduced to match your enrollment.

data.label: [ACTION] Reconcile Pell Grant Invoice
data.title: Reconcile Pell Grant Invoice
data.description: Pell Grant reduction may generate an invoice on student bill.
data.source_sentence: The amount of your Pell Grant award offer will be reduced to match your enrollment.

data.label: [CONTACT] Contact Cal Student Central
data.title: Contact Cal Student Central
data.description: Consult advisor to review individual award adjustments.
data.source_sentence: Contact Cal Student Central to find out how your individual awards may change.

data.label: ⚠️ [POLICY GAP] This policy does not specify what happens if an alternate resolution occurs.
data.title: Policy Gap: Unhandled Branch
data.description: This policy does not specify what happens if an alternate resolution occurs.
data.callScript: Hello, my name is [Your Name], student ID [My ID]. I am following the university's UC Berkeley Financial Aid Disbursement and Enrollment Adjustment Procedure for "Assess Reduced Course Load Status". The official policy does not specify what to do if an alternate resolution occurs.. Could you connect me with Cal Student Central to confirm how I should proceed?
